WITH web AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount, p.category,
         (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_member,
         (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS order_member
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
)
SELECT fiscal_period,
  sum(net_amount) all_incl_test,
  sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) test_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) web_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND line_member THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) member_line_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND order_member THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) member_order_net,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND line_member THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) raw_pct,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND order_member THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) corrected_pct
FROM web GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount, (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS is_member
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_member THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct
FROM web GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
